downward_budget.scope: Existing real API diagnostic; includes Conv and is not an estimate of additive or unprofiled savings. GDN accounts for75497472 of78446592 bytes per copy. Need composed API to determine benefit.

mechanism: One coupled candidate: startup FP8 ownership/input layouts previously admitted in v126, plus complete GDN prefix ownership. Multirow first row reads selected prior GDN through48 device pointer slots; remaining rows retain direct fixed immutable prefix slots. Commit selects completed GDN storage through typed state/runner views instead of copying75.5MB. Conv, hidden, full logits, target/draft KV and observer synchronization remain complete. No pointer-bank Graph multiplication.
equivalence: Every original recurrence, BF16 state round, FP32 output accumulation, norm/gate and projection remains unchanged. Pointer indirection changes the source address only. Exact input/output alias is already supported; prior selected GDN can alias a destination because each layer consumes its entry state before later rows overwrite it, and abort poisons uncertain state.
lineage: v126 is reopened only as a dependency of this bounded full-publication architecture, never retained alone. First-prefix-only and VMM remapping remain closed. This candidate changes logical GDN ownership rather than preserving a fixed virtual address or merely optimizing memcpy.
ownership_contract_to_implement: Only build-isolated noninstallable whole-core MTP permits selected GDN storage inside request-owned dead family workspace. Ordinary production RequestState ABI and route stay unchanged.

Typed GDN views must identify selected complete storage and actual arena offset; all consumers, including scalar tail and full-state oracle, must observe it. Raw allocation plus original plan offset is physical backing, not the selected MTP GDN view.

Before each observer, complete Conv, selected GDN, live KV, normalized hidden, full logits and logical positions match scalar. Immutable prefix slots remain unchanged during commit; next transaction may reuse them after previous transaction retirement.

All request-entry/reset, poison recovery, destruction and construction-failure paths must restore fixed physical view ownership safely. Prefill cannot overwrite live selected GDN. Public non-MTP borrowed-view semantics remain unchanged.
Keep a separate immutable entry hidden; no entry hidden alias with an overwritten GDN prefix. No request allocation or CPU node-update loop.

dependency_expiry: Indirect entry may remain only through the next two integration/API milestones; no independent tuning or indefinite retention.
